sections.installation:
🚀 Quick Setup in Under 5 Minutes!

Method 1: WordPress Admin (Recommended)
1. Navigate to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard
2. Search for “Ultimate Spin Wheel”
3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
4. Go to Ultimate Spin Wheel in your dashboard sidebar
5. Follow the setup wizard to create your first wheel

Method 2: Manual Upload
1. Download the plugin ZIP file
2. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/ultimate-spin-wheel directory
3. Activate through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
4. Access the plugin settings via Ultimate Spin Wheel menu

Method 3: FTP Upload
1. Unzip the plugin file
2. Upload the ultimate-spin-wheel folder to /wp-content/plugins/
3. Activate the plugin through WordPress admin

📋 Post-Installation Checklist:
– ✅ Verify WooCommerce is installed and active
– ✅ Configure your first spin wheel prizes
– ✅ Set up email capture settings
– ✅ Test the wheel on different devices
– ✅ Review analytics dashboard

🎯 Quick Start Guide:
1. Create your first wheel with pre-made templates
2. Add prizes (discounts, free shipping, etc.)
3. Customize appearance to match your brand
4. Set display triggers and targeting rules
5. Launch and start converting visitors!
sections.faq:
🎪 General Questions

How can Ultimate Spin Wheel increase my sales?

Ultimate Spin Wheel leverages proven gamification psychology to boost conversions by 200-300%. It captures emails, reduces bounce rates, prevents cart abandonment with exit-intent triggers, and creates engaging experiences that turn visitors into customers. The interactive nature makes discounts feel earned rather than given away.

Is Ultimate Spin Wheel compatible with my theme and plugins?

Yes! Ultimate Spin Wheel works with ALL WordPress themes and is compatible with major plugins including WooCommerce, Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, Gutenberg, WPML, Yoast SEO, and caching plugins like WP Rocket and W3 Total Cache.

Can I customize the wheel design to match my brand?

Absolutely! You have complete design control including:
– Custom colors, gradients, and backgrounds
– Upload your own logos and images
– Advanced typography settings
– Animation speeds and effects
– Sound controls and celebrations
– Mobile-responsive layouts

🎯 Technical Questions

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes! Ultimate Spin Wheel is built mobile-first with touch-optimized interactions. The wheel automatically adapts to all screen sizes and provides smooth spinning on iOS, Android, and all mobile browsers.

Will it slow down my website?

No! The plugin is optimized for speed with:
– Lazy loading technology
– Compressed assets
– CDN-ready files
– Cache compatibility
– Loads only when needed (trigger-based)
– Average load time impact: <0.1 seconds

Is it GDPR compliant?

Yes! Ultimate Spin Wheel includes:
– Built-in GDPR compliance tools
– Cookie consent integration
– Data export/deletion capabilities
– Privacy policy integration
– Explicit consent mechanisms
– Secure data storage

🏆 Features & Customization

How many prizes can I add to the wheel?

Unlimited! You can create as many wheel segments as needed. Popular configurations include:
– 6-8 segments for balanced gameplay
– 12+ segments for variety
– Mix of high-value and smaller prizes
– “Try again” or “Better luck next time” segments

Can I control winning probabilities?

Yes! You have granular control over:
– Individual prize winning chances
– Overall win/lose ratios
– Time-based probability changes
– User-specific winning rules
– Inventory-based prize availability

What types of rewards can I offer?

Ultimate Spin Wheel supports:
– Percentage discounts (5%, 10%, 25%, 50% off)
– Fixed amount discounts ($5, $10, $25 off)
– Free shipping offers
– Buy-one-get-one deals
– Free product samples
– Loyalty points
– Custom messages and non-monetary prizes

📧 Email Marketing

How does email capture work?

The wheel requires email entry before spinning, creating a natural lead magnet. Features include:
– Customizable opt-in forms
– Double opt-in support
– Export to CSV/Excel
– Integration with major email platforms
– Automatic list segmentation
– Welcome email automation

Can I integrate with my email marketing service?

Yes! (Upcoming) Ultimate Spin Wheel integrates with:
– MailChimp
– Constant Contact
– AWeber
– ConvertKit
– GetResponse
– ActiveCampaign
– And many more via Zapier

🎮 Gameplay & Triggers

When does the spin wheel appear?

You have complete control with multiple trigger options:
– Immediately on page load
– After X seconds delay
– When user scrolls X% down the page
– Exit intent (when about to leave)
– On specific pages or products
– For specific user types (new vs returning)

Can I target specific visitors?

Yes! Advanced targeting includes:
– Geographic targeting (countries, states, cities)
– Device targeting (desktop, tablet, mobile)
– Browser targeting
– Traffic source targeting
– User behavior targeting
– Time-based targeting (days, hours)

How do I prevent spam or abuse?

Built-in protection includes:
– IP-based restrictions
– Email validation
– Rate limiting (one spin per email/IP)
– Fraud detection algorithms
– Honeypot protection
– Manual moderation options

📊 Analytics & Reporting

What analytics are included?

Comprehensive reporting dashboard with:
– Total spins and conversions
– Email capture rates
– Prize distribution analytics
– Revenue attribution
– Geographical data
– Device and browser statistics
– Time-based performance charts

🛠️ Setup & Support

Do I need coding skills to use this plugin?

Not at all! Ultimate Spin Wheel features:
– Intuitive drag-and-drop builder
– Pre-made templates
– One-click setup wizard
– Visual customization tools
– No code required anywhere

What support do you provide?

We offer comprehensive support including:
– Detailed documentation
– Video tutorials
– Email support
– Community forums
– Live chat assistance
– Setup consultation (premium plans)

Is there a money-back guarantee?

Yes! We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee. If you’re not completely satisfied with Ultimate Spin Wheel’s performance, we’ll refund your purchase – no questions asked.
